{{Otheruses|Canister}}
A '''smoke canister''' was an ammunition round that was used with the [[CSPL-12 projectile launcher/Legends|CSPL-12]] [[Projectile launcher/Legends|projectile launcher]]. The canister released a cloud of smoke upon impact. [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Delevar]] used one to subdue the crew of an [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|All Terrain Scout Transport]] that stumbled across the [[Endor strike team/Legends|strike team's]] camp during their mission to destroy the [[Endor shield generator bunker]].
